purpose: Track AMD Instinct MI350P as a standard PCIe CDNA 4 accelerator for enterprise and large-model inference.

llm_relevance: 144GB single-card HBM capacity can hold substantially larger models than most PCIe accelerators
4TB/s HBM3E bandwidth is attractive for bandwidth-bound autoregressive decode
450W configurable mode can reduce infrastructure demands relative to 600W maximum TBP
standard PCIe form factor enables deployment in existing air-cooled enterprise servers
hardware.clusterability_note: Unlike MI355X OAM deployments, MI350P is primarily a PCIe card. Multi-GPU model parallelism should be evaluated with host/server PCIe and network topology rather than assuming OAM-class Infinity Fabric scale-up behavior.
hardware.availability_note: AMD positions MI350P for deployment in existing enterprise PCIe infrastructure. Dell PowerEdge XE7745 is one documented 8-GPU server platform; Dell lists the server as Contact Sales rather than exposing a stable MI350P configuration price.

benchmark_evidence.note: AMD publishes methodology and token-per-dollar comparisons versus H200 NVL/RTX PRO 6000, but the captured source does not provide a simple normalized absolute tok/s result suitable for the repository's cross-platform benchmark table.

open_questions: standalone card street price and availability
tokens per watt at 450W versus 600W TBP
multi-card scaling over PCIe and server fabric
used-market pricing once decommissioned systems appear
